##### Project general facts

Soléva Beach Residences by Al Huzaifa Properties is a beachfront residential building and the first residential project born from the brand's legacy in luxury furniture and interiors. Designed by VELA in a Luxury Coastal Modernism style, its sculpted form features rounded edges inspired by sea breeze erosion. The building rises above two basement levels and a ground floor to eight residential floors and a rooftop, offering fully furnished studios and one- and two-bedroom apartments, with every two-bedroom home featuring a private pool.

Amenities extend across the ground floor, a dedicated wellness level and the rooftop. Residents enjoy valet service, a concierge, a co-working lounge, a bike and scooter hub, a water sports pavilion and direct park and beach access. The wellness level brings together a spa, salon and massage suites, a cryo cabin, cold plunge baths, jacuzzi lounges, steam rooms and sauna suites. The rooftop offers an infinity pool with floating daybeds, scenic cabanas, a kids' splash pool, a sunken sky garden, a sky pavilion, a fire pit lounge and a barbecue area.

Interiors are designed to feel calm and light, with floor-to-ceiling glass opening onto sea, beach and park views. Living areas feature custom joinery, natural-toned finishes and fully included furnishings with neutral upholstery and accent lighting. Bathrooms offer walk-in rainfall showers and custom stone vanities, while one- and two-bedroom homes include walk-in closets. An owner's app allows guest access, housekeeping and service charges to be managed remotely.

##### Location description and benefits

Al Marjan Island is a group of reclaimed islands off the coast of Ras Al Khaimah, known for its pristine beaches, beachfront resorts and clubs. Nikki Beach, Rixos Bab Al Bahr and Nobu Hotel and Residences sit alongside the Wynn Al Marjan Island integrated resort, while parks, trails, play areas and a running and cycling promenade line the waterfront, creating a relaxed resort atmosphere throughout the day.

The Wynn resort lies within a short drive, and Al Hamra Mall, Al Hamra Golf Club and Al Hamra Marina and Yacht Club are also close by. Jet skiing, kayaking and other water sports are available along the shoreline. Ras Al Khaimah International Airport is easily reached, and Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road connects residents with Dubai and Dubai International Airport.

Al Marjan Island is a freehold destination open to international buyers, with full foreign ownership and no personal income tax. The arrival of the Wynn integrated resort is driving strong growth in tourism, hospitality and holiday rental demand across the island. Furnished beachfront homes in limited supply appeal to both investors seeking rental income and buyers looking for a coastal second home.
